0022600127.text: The Warriors are 0-2 and 13th in the West, third in the Pacific and two games back, and they have lost both games on the road and in their last two outings. The Nuggets are 1-1 and 8th in the West, fourth in the Northwest and one game back, with a win in their most recent game and a 1-0 home record. Listed as out for Golden State are Al Horford, Brandin Podziemski, Draymond Green, Jimmy Butler III, Kristaps Porzingis, Moses Moody and Stephen Curry, while Denver is without Alpha Diallo, Cameron Johnson, Julian Strawther and Spencer Jones. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their four 2025-26 meetings 2-2, with the Warriors' most recent meeting a 116-93 loss in Denver on March 29, 2026.
